entry.summary:
Would you study nursing if your classroom looked like this? 👀

Before stepping into a real hospital, EIT nursing students build confidence, develop clinical skills and practice in Te Kahikatea – our Clinical Simulation Suite, a realistic healthcare environment designed to prepare them for the real world.
